earnings.title: 767 Fifth Avenue
highlights: As Reported Net sales increased 7% to $3.7 billion.

quotes.text: Our first quarter of fiscal 2027 marks another powerful step forward for The Estée Lauder Companies. Growth is accelerating, profitability is strengthening significantly, and the impact of Beauty Reimagined is becoming increasingly evident across our business.
quotes.by: Stéphane de La Faverie, President and CEO

outlook: Organic net sales growth of 4.0% to 5.5%, ranging from the mid-point to above the high-end of the previously communicated range of 3% to 5%
Adjusted operating margin to range between 12.9% to 13.7%, an increase from the previously communicated range of 12.7% to 13.5%
Adjusted diluted net earnings per common share to range between $3.20 to $3.45, an increase from the previously communicated range of $3.10 to $3.35
